The present petition is filed under section 482 Cr.P.C. for quashing of FIR bearing no.0089/2018 dated 10.05.2018 registered under sections 498A/406/34 IPC at P.S. Sadar Bazar along with consequential proceedings.
2. Issue notice.

3. Mr. Utkarsh, Additional Public Prosecutor assisted by the Investigating Officer SI Rajbir Singh,
P.S. Sadar Bazar, accepts notice on behalf of the respondent no.1/State.
The respondent no.2 is present in person and accepts notice.
4. The petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 got married on 01.05.2016 according to Muslim rites and customs and out of their marriage, two children were born.
Subsequently, matrimonial differences stated to be arisen between the petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2.

sentences.text: The respondent no.2 due to matrimonial differences, got registered FIR bearing no.0089/2018 under sections 498A/406/34 IPC at P.S. Sadar Bazar wherein the petitioners were implicated.
The petitioners no. 2 to 4 are the family members/relatives of the petitioner no. 1.
The petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 are identified by the Investigating Officer SI Rajbir Singh, P.S. Sadar Bazar.

After conclusion of investigation, the charge-sheet was filed and the trial is stated to be pending in the court of Ms. Divyashree Raina, MM, Mahila Court, Tis Hazari Courts,
Delhi/Successor Court.

entities.text:
Mahila Court, Tis Hazari Courts,
Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 6. The petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 have settled their disputes vide Settlement Deed stated to be executed on 12.04.2021 and out of the Settlement, they have agreed to live together happily at their matrimonial home with mutual love, affection and understanding.

Since 12.04.2021,
the petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 are living together with mutual love, affection and understanding.

7. The counsel for the petitioners stated that the since 12.04.2021, the petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 are living together happily with mutual love, affection and understanding as such,
the present petition be allowed and FIR bearing no.0089/2018 be quashed along with consequential judicial proceedings.

8. The respondent no. 2 stated that she has settled with the petitioner no.1 out of her own free will and without any force, fear or coercion and she is living happily with the petitioner no. 1 in the matrimonial home as such, she does not have any objection if the present petition is allowed and FIR bearing no.0089/2018 is quashed along with consequential judicial proceedings.
9. The Additional Public Prosecutor for the State/respondent no. 1 stated This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 22/09/2023 at 21:51:13 that under the given facts and circumstances, he does not have any objection if the present petition is allowed and FIR bearing no.0089/2018 is quashed along with consequential judicial proceedings.

10. The petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 got married on 01.05.2016 and they have settled their disputes vide Settlement Deed dated 12.04.2021 and since then, they are living together with mutual love, affection and understanding.
No useful purpose shall be served if the proceedings arising out of FIR bearing no.0089/2018 is allowed to be continued and it would be an exercise in futility.

After considering all facts, the present petition is allowed and FIR bearing no.0089/2018 dated 10.05.2018 registered under sections 498A/406/34 IPC at P.S. Sadar Bazar along with consequential proceedings including judicial proceedings stated to be pending in the court of Ms.
Divyashree Raina, MM, Mahila Court, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi/Successor Court is quashed.

sentences.text: 11. The present petition along with pending applications, stands disposed of.
